_comment: AC-O2 denylist — open-ended ambient pools only (gossip, react-colleague-*, banter, murmurs). Status-ack pools (*-working/*-done/*-error) are EXEMPT (licensed status echo). This file is the T1 machine-gate artifact for ADR-007 D2.
_scope_note: Lint targets: gossip, react-colleague-*, banter (future), murmurs (future). Out of scope: contextBubbles.*-working, *-done, *-error, bubbles.*, eventBubbles.*, skillBubbles.*, statusLabels.*.

en._comment: Case-insensitive word-boundary match on these work-outcome STEMS.

zh._comment: Substring match on completion verb+了 collocations. NOT the bare particle 了. Negation lookbehind: if immediately preceded by a zhNegationPrefix, the match does NOT fire.
